name: Harmony Touch 8.3, favourites of ours and a logo of ours
summary: The favourites in a new order with a channel added, each tapped: its channel as digits to the LG TV; and the logo of ours.
description: todo-touch.md 8.3, on the bench Harmony Touch holding work/touch-firmware/sets/8.3-favourites: the six documents of 8.2's put back, the user's favourites document of ours and a logo of ours; the tuning device's favourites and the line up as the remote held them (packages/corpus/touch-favourites/8.3-favourites.json). Every expectation is derived by packages/bench/src/touchengine.ts. Step 1 presses Off and is not judged. In step 2, before tapping, write in the problem field the order the favourites screen shows, reading each row left to right, and which logos show; predicted 6 tiles in this order: BB1 (channel 61, added, its tile showing our logo, the text 8.3 in dark blue on yellow), RTL 4 (channel 4), NPO 3 (channel 3), NPO 2 (channel 2), NPO 1 (channel 1), Zork (channel 666). Every logo but the added channel's is the one it showed before; the added channel's tile shows the number under our logo. If the old station logo shows there instead, note it: the screens keep a picture they have drawn in memory by its file name until it is pushed out or the remote restarts. Predicted: the first tap, with no activity running, starts Watch TV and sends the digits at the end of the start; every later tap only the digits, padded to 3 digits, each about 100 ms after the one before. Two equal digits in a row are separate presses. Wait for the codes to stop before pressing Next: an activity start runs about 15 seconds, most of it the LG TV's power on delay.
